items.text: Small employer tired of group plan renewals? An ICHRA, now also called a CHOICE Arrangement, lets you set a fixed monthly allowance and lets each employee choose their own individual plan. You decide the budget. They decide the coverage. No participation minimums to meet. We can show you how it would work for your team. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146 or visit honorbrook-insurance.com.
items.image_alt: Honorbrook Insurance graphic. Group plan vs. ICHRA. Group plan: One plan picked for everyone; Renewal cost set by the carrier; Participation minimums apply. ICHRA: You set a fixed allowance; Each employee picks a plan; No participation minimums.
